overview.description: The REX-Osprey DOGE ETF (DOJE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long doge, short usd currency. The fund provides exposure to the price of Dogecoin. The fund holds assets designed to track DOGEs spot value, offering a way to gain price exposure without directly holding the cryptocurrency. DOJE was launched on Sep 18, 2025 and is issued by REX-Osprey.
